about: Intent register, slice 0 of the cinematic program. Every visible region and every motion on two views has an entry: what the person needs to know or do, and why it moves. tests/unit/intent-register.test.mjs fails when a visible element on either view is not covered. Captured at 390x844 on 2026-11-06 with the page clock pinned and no API (static data only).
tiers: hero = the one thing to read or do; context = what orients; periphery = atmosphere that carries no information. Slice 1 (2026-11-06): the table has one hero, the Sign-ups tile (the member's own answer to the invitation), at full brightness; the countdown, the five and the library search are context (about 66 percent); the rest of the wall is periphery (about 46 percent). Tiers are data-tier attributes in index.html and css/hierarchy.css.
not_covered: Next steps for a signed-in member (the member card needs the API state; the stub snapshot has no per-member route). Add in slice 1 with a fixture.
Every other scene and every non-idle state (pressed, submitting, failed, offline): later slices, one register entry per state.
